mapper.select: SELECT `id`,`tenant_id`,`source_system`,`source_record_key`,`source_version`,`company_id`,`company_code`,`company_name`,`order_type`,`order_no`,`sales_type`,`contract_no`,`execution_no`,`customer_id`,`customer_code`,`customer_name`,`source_project_name`,`order_comment`,`order_amount`,`currency_code`,`authority_status`,`source_lifecycle_status`,`order_create_time`,`customer_required_time`,`custom_info`,`source_sync_time`,`source_updated_at`,`status`,`version`,`creator`,`create_time`,`updater`,`update_time`,`deleted` FROM com_sales_order WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND ((source_system=#{key.sourceSystem} AND company_code=#{key.companyCode} AND order_type=#{key.orderType} AND order_no=#{key.orderNo}))AND 1=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE com_sales_order SET `source_version`=#{row.order.sourceVersion},`sales_type`=#{row.order.salesType},`contract_no`=#{row.order.contractNo},`execution_no`=#{row.order.executionNo},`customer_code`=#{row.order.customerCode},`customer_name`=#{row.order.customerName},`source_project_name`=#{row.order.sourceProjectName},`order_comment`=#{row.order.orderComment},`source_lifecycle_status`=#{row.order.sourceLifecycleStatus},`order_create_time`=#{row.order.orderCreateTime},`customer_required_time`=#{row.order.customerRequiredTime},`source_sync_time`=#{row.order.sourceSyncTime},`source_updated_at`=#{row.order.sourceUpdatedAt},`status`=#{row.order.status},`version`=#{row.order.version},`updater`=#{row.order.updater},`update_time`=#{row.order.updateTime} WHERE tenant_id=#{context.tenantId} AND id=#{row.order.id} AND version=#{row.expectedVersion} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT `id`,`tenant_id`,`order_id`,`source_system`,`source_record_key`,`source_version`,`company_id`,`company_code`,`company_name`,`order_type`,`order_no`,`line_no`,`line_type`,`product_code`,`product_model`,`product_desc`,`custom_info`,`product_id`,`bundle_code`,`profit_center`,`real_execution_no`,`warranty_month`,`customer_id`,`customer_code`,`customer_name`,`order_qty`,`open_qty`,`delivered_qty`,`unit_code`,`unit_scale`,`quantity_status`,`source_lifecycle_status`,`source_sync_time`,`source_updated_at`,`status`,`version`,`creator`,`create_time`,`updater`,`update_time`,`deleted` FROM com_sales_order_line WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND ((source_system=#{key.sourceSystem} AND company_code=#{key.companyCode} AND line_type=#{key.lineType} AND order_no=#{key.orderNo} AND line_no=#{key.lineNo}))AND 1=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE com_sales_order_line SET `source_version`=#{row.line.sourceVersion},`line_type`=#{row.line.lineType},`product_code`=#{row.line.productCode},`product_desc`=#{row.line.productDesc},`bundle_code`=#{row.line.bundleCode},`profit_center`=#{row.line.profitCenter},`real_execution_no`=#{row.line.realExecutionNo},`warranty_month`=#{row.line.warrantyMonth},`customer_code`=#{row.line.customerCode},`customer_name`=#{row.line.customerName},`order_qty`=#{row.line.orderQty},`open_qty`=#{row.line.openQty},`delivered_qty`=#{row.line.deliveredQty},`source_lifecycle_status`=#{row.line.sourceLifecycleStatus},`source_sync_time`=#{row.line.sourceSyncTime},`source_updated_at`=#{row.line.sourceUpdatedAt},`status`=#{row.line.status},`version`=#{row.line.version},`updater`=#{row.line.updater},`update_time`=#{row.line.updateTime} WHERE tenant_id=#{context.tenantId} AND id=#{row.line.id} AND version=#{row.expectedVersion} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT r.*,b.source_key AS raw_key FROM com_sales_order r JOIN int_base_sync_binding b ON b.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND b.target_id=r.id AND b.object_key='SALES_ORDER' AND b.deleted=FALSE JOIN int_base_sync_task t ON t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.id=b.task_id AND t.task_code='BASE_P14' AND t.connection_id=#{parameters.connectionId} AND t.deleted=FALSE WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.deleted=0 ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE com_sales_order SET company_id=CASE id WHEN #{row.order.id} THEN #{row.order.companyId} ELSE company_id END, company_name=CASE id WHEN #{row.order.id} THEN #{row.order.companyName} ELSE company_name END, version=version+1,update_time=update_time WHERE tenant_id=#{context.tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND id IN #{row.order.id} AND version=CASE id WHEN #{row.order.id} THEN #{row.expectedVersion} END
